headings.usage: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for all headings to emphasize the technical/futuristic feel. Never use Inter or Roboto for headings.

body.usage: Use regular for standard text, semibold for labels and UI elements.

surfaces.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (never fully transparent) with a delicate border-white/40 inner stroke for floating panels, sticky headers, and AI Mentor chat overlays.
surfaces.neumorphism: Use subtle flat solid backgrounds (bg-white) with crisp 1px border (border-black/5) and a soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm) for Dashboard Cards and Quiz UI.

visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to eliminate pure digital flatness, evoking a warm, sandy Caribbean feel.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), bg-[#E05A33] text-white, hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-lg transition-transform duration-300.
buttons.secondary: Rounded-full, bg-transparent border-2 border-[#143628] text-[#143628] hover:bg-[#143628] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300.

cards.formation_grid: Flat rectangular cards with 8px border-radius, crisp 1px border-border, no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), soft shadow (shadow-lg), border color darkens to primary orange.

frek_id_profile.style: Technical/Futuristic terminal-like card but in light mode context. Use monospace fonts for signals (FREK-TIME/WORK/SCORE) with subtle orange glowing accents.

ai_mentor.style: Conversational sidebar with high-end glassmorphism (bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-2xl). Messages from mentor have soft orange gradients, user messages are crisp white with borders.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High Density Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). North Star metric (Global Progression) in top-left (col-span-2). Missions and Badges in narrow vertical feeds (col-span-1 row-span-2).
grids_and_layouts.roadmap: Horizontal scrolling container (flex overflow-x-auto) with snap-x snap-mandatory. Massive spacing (gap-12) between the 6 stages (Graine to Forêt).
grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. Tailwind scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12. Containers with borders MUST have p-6 or p-8 internal padding.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must explicitly set text color on hover. Use scale and subtle translate transforms.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Smooth fade and slight upward slide using framer-motion.
motion_and_interactions.roadmap_scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling on the horizontal roadmap.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text. All focus states must have a highly visible ring-2 ring-[#E05A33].

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media_and_assets.icons: Use iconoir-react for a distinctive, non-corporate technical look that fits the 'futuristic' vibe.

hero_background.description: Calm sea during golden hour. Use with a white/sand gradient overlay to ensure text readability.

roadmap_stages.description: Closeup photo of green plants for the botanical progression metaphor.

architectural_accents.description: Futuristic white and orange architecture to use in header/hero backgrounds subtly.

3d_and_creative_libraries.recommendation: Use Framer Motion for UI micro-interactions and page transitions.
3d_and_creative_libraries.scrolling: Implement Lenis for buttery smooth momentum scrolling, critical for the premium 'Academy OS' feel.

general_instructions_for_main_agent: You are building 'CVLN Academy OS', a futuristic Caribbean learning platform.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use a fully transparent background on headers or overlays. Always use at least bg-white/70 with backdrop-blur-xl.
CRITICAL: Output all React components in `.js` files, not `.tsx` files.
Implement a trilingual toggle (FR/EN/KR) prominently in the header or sidebar (FR is default).
Do not center-align the app container. Respect optical alignment.
Always apply data-testid to buttons, form inputs, navigation links, and major display panels.
Use standard Shadcn components for complex logic (Select, Dialog, Tabs) but customize their Tailwind classes to match the 'Caribbean Futurism' aesthetic.
Avoid the generic 'Vercel Look' (grayscale). Infuse the white/orange/botanical green color palette strategically.
Install and use `iconoir-react` for all icons.
Ensure the FREK-ID dashboard prominently displays signals (FREK-TIME, SCORE) using a highly structured technical layout.
Use standard sonner component for toast notifications.
